# NFL Daily — 2026-08-09 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- 08/09: Lions QB Teddy Bridgewater is retiring from the NFL for the second time at age 33; Detroit quickly signed veteran Josh Dobbs to a one-year, $1.425M deal as Jared Goff's new backup. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49568593/teddy-bridgewater-leaves-lions-likely-retire-again-coach-says) — also [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/teddy-bridgewater-retires-lions-backup-quarterback-jared-goff/)
- 08/08: Commanders LT Laremy Tunsil suffered a torn triceps in practice, is expected to need surgery, and will likely miss most of the 2026 season. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49564238/commanders-lt-laremy-tunsil-suffers-torn-triceps) — also [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/commanders-laremy-tunsil-torn-triceps-will-miss-most-of-2026-season/)
- 08/09: Raiders held QB Kirk Cousins and DE Maxx Crosby out of practice for a second straight day for disciplinary reasons following their Friday fight. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49561930/raiders-hold-cousins-crosby-practice-day-scuffle)
- 08/08: Pro Football Hall of Fame inducted its 2026 class, including Drew Brees, Larry Fitzgerald and Luke Kuechly. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49562701/brees-fitzgerald-kuechly-enter-pro-football-hall-fame)
- 08/08: New Hall of Famer Roger Craig revealed during his induction speech that he has been diagnosed with vascular dementia. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49562214/new-hall-famer-roger-craig-reveals-dementia-diagnosis)
- 08/09: Saints G Dillon Radunz is out for the season after tearing his ACL in Saturday's practice. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49568453/saints-dillon-radunz-season-torn-acl)
